name: kd-knowledge-denial
description: paper16's 26 personas plus 10 knowledge-denial personas, all answering the same 30 questions. Adds the behaviour paper16 lacks -- deception by denying knowledge one has -- with two honest contrasts: sincere_ignorance (same words, truthfully meant) and plain_assertion (unhedged assertion).
question_set: 20 questions copied verbatim from src/assistant_axis_ndif/pc_questions_shared.jsonl (the paper's 10 deception + first 10 sycophancy, Appendix C) plus 10 new knowledge-admission questions. All 36 personas answer all 30.

contrasts.name: deception
contrasts.note: Eq 4, Mahadik & Skapars -- unchanged from paper16

contrasts.name: unified
contrasts.note: Appendix C unified harmful axis -- unchanged from paper16

contrasts.name: knowledge_denial
contrasts.note: NEW. Both sides deny knowledge; only sincerity differs, so this axis cannot be a wording artifact. The primary object of this experiment.

contrasts.name: kd_assertion
contrasts.note: NEW. Denial against flat assertion -- the register contrast, kept separate so it can be told apart from knowledge_denial.

honesty.note: completeness of the record as the governing value

assistant_anchor.note: the paper's default anchor; reuses the existing AA role

knowledge_denial.note: the lie IS feigned ignorance: knowledge held and denied

sincere_ignorance.note: denies knowledge sincerely -- same words as knowledge_denial, truthfully meant

plain_assertion.note: honest and unhedged -- asserts knowledge plainly, unlike the hedged honesty group
